title: Request (neuroverse-governance/1)
description: One question: may this participant, under this principal, call this tool in this scope with these arguments, given these facts? SPEC.md § 16.3. Everything but `tool` and `args` comes from the harness.

principal.description: The human (or account) whose authority the participant acts under.

delegatedBy.description: The participant that delegated to this one. Requires `delegation`.

delegation.description: The chain from the principal's direct agent down to participant.delegatedBy, outermost first, as the harness assembled it.

args.description: The real argument payload. Declared fields bind to facts; anything else is refused (args_wellformed).

facts.description: Harness-supplied facts (derived and supplied) by ID, plus the built-in approvedBy. A fact bound to an argument is not supplied here.
